provenance: Original fictional creative inputs. Not finished levels, measured playtest results or real navigation advice.

briefs.goal: Bring a fragile seed archive through a reef settlement; decide whose beacon to repair first.
briefs.tension: The quick passage leaves little clearance for a wide cargo arrangement; a longer route meets a settlement that needs a useful module.
briefs.quality: Read the route before committing, understand the trade-off, retreat and rearrange without losing all progress.
briefs.consequence: The repaired beacon changes guidance on a later voyage.

briefs.goal: Locate a drifting library and reconstruct why it left its harbour.
briefs.tension: Landmarks are partly obscured; two recovered accounts disagree about the return route.
briefs.quality: Understand navigation with sound disabled and reduced motion; comparing accounts changes a real route choice.
briefs.consequence: The chosen account affects trust and access at the next settlement.

briefs.goal: Return a recovered lens while a temporary storm closes the expected passage.
briefs.tension: The reef loadout is cumbersome here; shelter and replanning remain viable.
briefs.quality: Communicate the changed condition before unavoidable failure; recovery works on a narrow touch screen.
briefs.consequence: The repaired lens provides another way to orient during the resolution.

revision.change: The archive must remain on deck, and the old shortcut is unavailable on the return leg.
revision.preserve: Earned discoveries and retreat; old expedition saves keep their original rules.
revision.question: Can a player understand the limitation, revise the vessel and complete an alternative route?
revision.resource_change: Halve the initial measured texture-download budget and handle an unavailable selected variant using a local replay fixture; retain recognisable landmarks and the source record.
revision.comparison: Run the previously working acquisition/design/review approach on this changed request before revising it. Preserve its output and measured work, then compare the revised approach on identical inputs and replay another voyage.

transfer: Author another expedition with different objectives, topology and constraints through the same studio; renamed landmarks do not establish transfer.

resource_requests.need: Weathered timber and rock materials plus daylight lighting that keep reef edges readable.
resource_requests.constraints: Discover real assets; inspect available variants, licence and sizes; choose a compatible bounded pack.

resource_requests.need: A different lighting and material combination for fog, with readable landmarks and no essential sound cue.
resource_requests.constraints: Reuse the acquisition path with new selections; do not present a daylight pack with renamed scenery as the result.
